instructions: Enter or scan the code currently displayed on the device. Codes change every 30 seconds. Check the device, then explicitly approve it.

states.success: Device approved. It will reconnect with its new credentials.
states.denied: You must be signed in with permission to manage equipment.
states.expired: The code expired or the device disconnected. Enter its current code.
states.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait one minute before trying again.
states.busy: Approval is busy or the device changed codes. Check the current code and try again.
states.failed: Enrollment failed. Check the connection and use a fresh code. Credentials are never resent.
states.invalidScan: This is not a current enrollment QR code for this device type.
states.camera: Camera unavailable or permission denied. Enter the code manually.
